newsitem.title: USA: NPS Pharmaceuticals begins stroke trial.
newsitem.headline: NPS Pharmaceuticals begins stroke trial.

text.p: NPS Pharmaceuticals Inc said Tuesday it had begun Phase I clinical trials to test the safety of its drug candidate for limiting brain damage to survivors of stroke.
The company said clinical trials began July 25 with healthy volunteers to evaluate the safety of various intravenous doses of the compound, known as NPS 1506.

NPS said the drug apparently regulates sites on the brain known as "NMDA" receptors, blocking influx of calcium into brain cells after a stroke -- thereby protecting cells until blood flow is restored to the affected area of the brain.
